RECREATIONAL.gov_quote: South Dakota's cannabis program is medical-only. Only verified patients and caregivers have access to medical cannabis.

RECREATIONAL.question: Is it legal for adults to possess cannabis in the state of South Dakota?
RECREATIONAL.gov_section: The South Dakota Medical Cannabis Program has a statewide patient registry, verification, and licensing system that will ensure that only verified patients and caregivers have access to medical cannabis.

MEDICAL.gov_quote: Registered patients and caregivers may be dispensed up to three ounces of cannabis flower over a rolling 14-day period.
MEDICAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-09 found gov_section verbatim on https://doh.sd.gov/programs/medical-cannabis/patients-cargivers-practitioners/cardholder-purchase-limits/.
MEDICAL.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to possess cannabis in the state of South Dakota?
MEDICAL.gov_section: South Dakota utilizes a rolling limit that allows for the purchase of three ounces of flower over 14 days. The 14-day rolling limit is tracked when medical cannabis is physically dispensed to a Patient or Caregiver.

MEDICAL_STORE.gov_quote: Any sale or purchase of medical cannabis must comply with SDCL 34-20G and ARSD 44:90. Any sale or purchase of cannabis outside of the regulated medical cannabis establishments is illegal.

MEDICAL_GROW.gov_quote: As part of the application process to obtain a registry identification card for the South Dakota Medical Cannabis Program, applicants may also apply to cultivate no more than two flowering cannabis plants and two cannabis plants that are not flowering plants in their home.

MEDICAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to grow cannabis in the state of South Dakota?

sourceNotes: This pass started from https://doh.sd.gov/ on 2026-09-08 and stayed on doh.sd.gov. The prior primaryGovUrl was https://medcannabis.sd.gov/, which now redirects to https://doh.sd.gov/programs/medical-cannabis, the Department of Health Medical Cannabis Program. That program page is the dedicated cannabis homepage used here. The patient, caregiver, and practitioner FAQ at /programs/medical-cannabis/patients-cargivers-practitioners/ answers that only verified patients and caregivers have access to medical cannabis, that sales must go through regulated establishments, and that card applicants may cultivate two flowering plants and two non-flowering plants at home. Cardholder purchase limits at /programs/medical-cannabis/patients-cargivers-practitioners/cardholder-purchase-limits/ state a rolling three-ounce flower purchase that is physically dispensed to a patient or caregiver. Licensed dispensaries are listed at /programs/medical-cannabis/med-cannabis-establishments/establishments-list/. The stored citations on sdlegislature.gov and the old medcannabis.sd.gov paths were replaced because those hosts are not the requested source and this host already answers the questions. Fetch with browser headers returns 200 and the excerpts are in the HTML, so these rows do not need a browser.
